name: Albert II of Germany
role: King of Hungary, Germany, and Bohemia
contribution: King of the Romans and a member of the House of Habsburg.

checks.lead: Albert II (German: Albrecht II., 10 August 1397 – 27 October 1439) was King of the Romans and a member of the House of Habsburg. By inheritance he became Albert V, Duke of Austria. Through his wife Elizabeth of Luxembourg (jure uxoris), he also became King of Hungary, King of Croatia, King of Bohemia, and inherited a claim to the Duchy of Luxembourg.
